features.name: Animal Companion
features.summary: Choose a full-level animal companion that shares teamwork feats and animal focus.

features.name: Animal Focus
features.summary: Apply one animal aspect to the Hunter as a swift action; the companion can maintain an aspect continuously.

features.name: Nature Training
features.summary: Count Hunter levels as both Druid and Ranger levels for feat prerequisites and effects.

features.name: Wild Empathy
features.summary: Improve an animal's attitude using Hunter level and Charisma.

features.name: Precise Companion
features.summary: Gain Precise Shot as a bonus feat while the companion gains the linked benefit.

features.name: Teamwork Feat
features.summary: Choose a teamwork feat and grant it to the animal companion.

features.name: Hunter Tactics
features.summary: The animal companion gains the Hunter's teamwork feats without meeting their prerequisites.

features.name: Improved Empathic Link
features.summary: Communicate basic concepts and perceive through the companion's senses at close range.

features.name: Woodland Stride
features.summary: Move through normal undergrowth without impairment.

features.name: Teamwork Feat
features.summary: Choose another teamwork feat.

features.name: Bonus Tricks
features.summary: The companion learns additional tricks beyond those granted by Intelligence.

features.name: Second Animal Focus
features.summary: Apply two different animal aspects simultaneously.

features.name: Teamwork Feat
features.summary: Choose another teamwork feat.

features.name: Raise Animal Companion
features.summary: Once per day, restore a dead animal companion as raise dead without material components.

features.name: Speak with Master
features.summary: Communicate verbally with the animal companion as though sharing a language.

features.name: Teamwork Feat
features.summary: Choose another teamwork feat.

features.name: Greater Empathic Link
features.summary: Extend empathic communication and sensory sharing to great distances.

features.name: Teamwork Feat
features.summary: Choose another teamwork feat.

features.name: Third Animal Focus
features.summary: Apply three different animal aspects simultaneously.

features.name: One with the Wild
features.summary: Animals and magical beasts begin with a more favourable attitude and may not attack without provocation.

features.name: Teamwork Feat
features.summary: Choose another teamwork feat.

features.name: Master Hunter
features.summary: Track at full speed and attempt a lethal master-hunter strike against a quarry.
